title: inventory.stock.snapshot — Payload Schema
description: Full snapshot of observable stock state across all products and locations, published by erp.inventory for initial indexing and periodic reconciliation. Each entry includes aggregate_available, which Commerce must use as the sole source of truth for availability. Consumers that detect a gap in stock_sequence values must trigger a snapshot reconciliation.

entries.description: Complete list of (product_id, location_id) stock records at the time of snapshot generation. A product absent from this list has zero stock at that location.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core.

location_id.description: Warehouse or storage location identifier. Single-warehouse tenants use 'warehouse-main'.

stock_sequence.description: Sequence value at the time the snapshot was taken for this (product_id, location_id) pair. Consumers can use this to resume processing incremental updates after the snapshot is applied.

quantity_on_hand.description: Physical units confirmed in inventory at snapshot time.

quantity_reserved.description: Units with an active reservation at snapshot time.

quantity_blocked.description: Units blocked for operational reasons at snapshot time.

quantity_adjustment.description: Signed correction applied at snapshot time. May be negative.

aggregate_available.description: Units that Commerce may sell. Computed by erp.inventory. Consumers must use this value directly and not recompute it.

snapshotted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when erp.inventory generated this snapshot.
